meta.title: Online Alarm Clock - S-Jiffy
meta.description: A web-based timer alarm that plays a ringtone when the time comes, supports hourly chime, and runs entirely locally.
desc: A web-based timer alarm that plays a ringtone when the time comes, supports hourly chime, and runs entirely locally.
ui.19: After setting the alarm you can minimize this window or switch to another page - it will still ring on time.
ui.20: The alarm runs entirely locally, so it still works offline; don't change the ringtone after setting the alarm.
ui.21: Ring volume depends on your device's speaker or headphone volume settings.
ui.33: Alarm stopped; set it again if you need another reminder
ui.34: Alarm is ringing - click stop or wait for it to end
ui.100: Audio synthesis is not supported in this browser
ui.101: Please enter a valid alarm time
